summary: Frontend was updated to call a new caller-safe ban check (actor.isCallerBanned()) before creating orders and to improve error handling/UI around admin access, but the diff summary does not provide evidence that the required backend APIs/authorization/audit-log changes were implemented. Several additional unrelated frontend changes appear to have been made beyond the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query method that lets an authenticated user check their own ban status without trapping for authorization reasons (e.g., isCallerBanned()), and frontend ban-check aligns with backend signature.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend now calls actor.isCallerBanned(), but the truncated backend/main.mo excerpt does not show any isCallerBanned (or equivalent) method being added/exposed, so backend support and signature alignment cannot be confirmed from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Order flow works for authenticated, non-banned users; pre-check does not fail; banned users are blocked with a clear English error message.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend implements a ban pre-check and shows a clear banned message, but the diff summary provides no evidence that backend order creation enforces bans server-side and returns appropriate English errors (backend/main.mo is truncated before any order-create/ban-enforcement logic is shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Any authenticated admin (not just owner) can grant admin access via grantAdminAccess(email); non-admin is rejected with an English unauthorized error; action is recorded in audit log with granting admin principal and target details.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows UI messaging indicating any admin can grant/revoke, but does not show backend authorization changes for grantAdminAccess nor audit log recording details (backend/main.mo is truncated and contains no visible grantAdminAccess/relevant authorization/audit log code in the excerpt).

missing_requirements.requirement: Any authenticated admin can revoke admin access via revokeAdminAccess(email) while preventing revoking OWNER_EMAIL; non-admin is rejected with an English unauthorized error; action is recorded in audit log with revoking admin principal and target details.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary includes UI copy about owner not being revocable and shows OWNER_EMAIL defined, but does not provide evidence that revokeAdminAccess authorization was changed to allow any admin, that owner revocation is blocked in the backend method, or that audit logging is performed (backend/main.mo is truncated).

hallucinated_features.description: Added a backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) even though no state schema change is evidenced in the provided diff summary.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest allows adding migration.mo only if state schema changes require it; the diff summary does not show a schema change necessitating migration (migration.run is a no-op returning old state).

hallucinated_features.description: Multiple unrelated frontend UI/UX and content changes (marketing pages/routes, styling/accessibility tweaks, watermark removal, export/print/toasts, etc.) beyond the requested ban-check and admin delegation fixes.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest scope is limited to fixing ban-check/order flow and admin delegation authorization; the frontend-file-summaries indicate broad changes to many components/pages not mentioned in requirements.
